rendered: The authors did not choose a melt-diffusion step of more than 20 hours. They actually used a significantly more scalable and less expensive method, called isothermal vapor phase infiltration, which lasted only 1 hour at 175 °C. This method allowed them to infiltrate the sulfur into the micropores of the carbon spheres, resulting in a 35 wt% sulfur loading.
